summary: Socket head cap screw with a cylindrical head and a hex drive socket in the head top. The head is 5.5 mm in diameter and 3 mm tall. The shank extends 6 mm below the head, so overall length is 9 mm. The screw axis is modeled along X, with the head toward -X.

mountingSurfaces.description: Underside of the head, which bears against the clamped part. The shank extends from here toward +X.
Flat top face of the head, which contains the hex drive socket.

notes: The drawing gives a 5.5 mm head diameter, 3 mm head height, 6 mm shank length measured from the underside of the head, and a 2.5 mm hex socket. Total length of 9 mm is head height plus shank length. The 2.5 mm hex socket is across flats, used here as the hole diameter. Socket depth is not stated, so it is modeled as a blind recess. The text spec lists length as 6 mm, which matches the shank length only and excludes the head. The bounding box is centered on the part, with x from -4.5 to 4.5. The shank diameter is not given as a separate dimension and is not modeled. The thread-locker tube in the third image is a separate accessory and is not part of this component.
